facts.f: The word {robot} comes from the Czech "robota", meaning forced labor.
facts.more: It first appeared in a 1920 play called R.U.R.

facts.f: The first recorded computer {bug} was a real moth.
facts.more: Engineers found it stuck in a Harvard Mark II relay in 1947 and taped it into the logbook.

facts.f: The term {artificial intelligence} was coined in 1955.
facts.more: It was written for a proposal for a 1956 summer workshop at Dartmouth.

facts.f: In 1950, Alan Turing proposed a test for machine intelligence he called {the imitation game.}
facts.more: Today we call it the Turing test.

facts.f: A 1966 chatbot named {ELIZA} convinced some people it understood them.
facts.more: It mostly rephrased their own words back as questions.

facts.f: IBM's Deep Blue beat world chess champion {Garry Kasparov} in 1997.
facts.more: It was the first time a computer beat a reigning champion in a full match.

facts.f: The first text message ever sent said {"Merry Christmas".}
facts.more: It was sent from a computer to a phone in December 1992.

facts.f: The first webcam watched a {coffee pot.}
facts.more: Cambridge researchers set it up in 1991 so they'd stop walking to an empty pot.

facts.f: {Bluetooth} is named after a 10th century Danish king.
facts.more: Harald "Bluetooth" Gormsson united Danish tribes. The tech unites devices.
Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart.

facts.f: The first item sold on eBay was a {broken laser pointer.}
facts.more: The buyer said he collected broken laser pointers.

facts.f: {Google} is named after "googol", a 1 followed by 100 zeros.
facts.more: The founders wanted a name that meant a huge amount of information.

facts.f: The first domain name ever registered was {symbolics.com.}

facts.more: It started as a company making playing cards.

facts.f: The first YouTube video is called {"Me at the zoo".}
facts.more: It's 19 seconds long and was uploaded in April 2005.

facts.f: Ray Tomlinson sent the first network email in 1971 and picked the {@ symbol} to separate names from computers.
facts.more: He said he chose it because it wasn't used in anyone's name.
